subject.title: fix(agents): route llama.cpp GBNF cleaning through provider tool-schema hooks

question: Should OpenClaw permanently support the explicit `compat.toolSchemaProfile: "llamacpp"` setting and the exported `llamacpp-gbnf` provider-tools family for external/custom provider plugins?
rationale: The code is a plausible, well-proven implementation, but it creates user-facing configuration and plugin-SDK contracts whose long-term scope, naming, and deprecation obligations cannot be selected mechanically.

options.title: Accept the public contracts
options.body: Merge the documented profile and SDK family as the canonical opt-in route for custom llama.cpp-compatible providers and provider plugins.

options.title: Limit to bundled providers
options.body: Keep the provider-owned hooks for bundled Ollama, LM Studio, and llama.cpp, but remove the new generic profile and public SDK-family commitment.

options.title: Pause for SDK direction
options.body: Hold this PR until plugin-SDK owners define whether backend-specific schema families should be public or remain bundled-only.

recommendation.title: Accept the public contracts
recommendation.body: Merge the documented profile and SDK family as the canonical opt-in route for custom llama.cpp-compatible providers and provider plugins.

likelyOwner.reason: The remaining decision concerns durable product and SDK scope rather than a mechanical implementation repair.
